message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; obvious aliases and duplicate entries were normalized across those two files. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-03 05:10 IST through 2026-10-04 05:10 IST** (2026-10-02 23:40 through 2026-10-03 23:40 UTC).

**No credible, newly reported vulnerabilities were found that both fall within the exact 24-hour window and confidently match the monitored primary-product scope.**

Fresh advisory records in the window were reviewed and excluded when they concerned unrelated products, unlisted WordPress plugins, or third-party Java/npm libraries rather than the named products themselves. Prominent Chrome, Firefox, Cisco, Fortinet, Grafana, and MongoDB reports encountered during research were also excluded when their original disclosure dates fell outside the window.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector/SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned security alerts, CVE/NVD-oriented records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported within the exact 24-hour window. Older MongoDB advisories and routine documentation updates were excluded.

### Sources checked

- [GitHub Advisory Database: advisories published October 3, 2026](https://github.com/advisories?query=published%3A2026-10-03)
- [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)
- [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)
- Vendor security advisories and release channels for the monitored product families

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this 24-hour scan. Continue normal monitoring; this conclusion is limited to publicly available, credibly dated reports that could be matched confidently to the assigned primary-product inventory.
